title: Love on the Open Sea
content:
Laura had always dreamed of traveling by boat. When her sister invited her on a week-long cruise along the Brazilian coast, she accepted immediately.

On the first evening, Laura was standing near the deck, watching the sunset, when she noticed a man looking at the ocean.

She walked over to him.

— Beautiful, isn't it?

The man smiled.

— It is. I've been waiting for this trip for months.

— Me too. I had been working almost every weekend before coming here.

— Then you definitely deserve a vacation.

His name was Daniel. They started talking, and soon they discovered that they had several things in common.

During the next few days, they spent more and more time together. They had been talking every morning before breakfast, and they had been exploring different parts of the boat in the afternoons.

One evening, the boat was moving slowly across the calm sea. Laura and Daniel were sitting on the upper deck when the sky suddenly became cloudy.

— It looks like we're going to have a storm.

— Yes. We've been lucky so far.

The wind became stronger, and everyone was asked to stay inside.

While the passengers were returning to their rooms, Daniel looked at Laura.

— Are you afraid?

— A little.

— Don't worry. I'll stay with you.

They found a quiet area near the restaurant and watched the rain through the large windows.

Daniel smiled.

— You know, I had been hoping to meet someone interesting on this trip.

Laura laughed.

— And did you?

— I think I did.

She looked at him, surprised.

— That's a very direct answer.

— I've been trying to find the courage to say it since the first day.

The storm continued for several hours, but eventually the rain stopped. The following morning, the sun was shining again, and the sea was calm.

As they watched the sunrise together, Laura realized that she had been waiting for a moment like this without even knowing it.

On the final evening, the boat was approaching the harbor.

— I can't believe the trip is almost over — Laura said.

Daniel looked at her.

— The trip is ending, but maybe something else is beginning.

Laura smiled.

— Maybe it is.

When they finally left the boat, neither of them wanted to say goodbye.

They had met by chance on the open sea, but after a week together, they both knew that their story didn't have to end when the journey did.

They had been looking for a memorable vacation.

Instead, they had found each other.
